[wizloop:once-at] A scheduled run of the loop file adapters/fixtures/t3/once-at.md. Do these steps in order. TIME below means the time now in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

1. Do this:
Remind the owner to read the release notes.

2. Last, append `TIME once-at ok WHAT` to .openwiz/home/once-at/ok.log, where WHAT is one line saying what you did; or, if step 1 failed, `TIME once-at failed WHY`.
